#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

file=$(find "{{root_dir}}" -type f -not -path '*/.git/*' \
  | fzf --preview 'bat --color=always --style=numbers {} 2>/dev/null || cat {}' \
        --preview-window=right:60% \
        --height=80% --border)

[ -n "$file" ] && {{editor}} "$file"
summary_zh: fzf 檔案選擇器附 bat preview 開編輯器
